claims: Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died are false.
Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died have been debunked as misinformation.
As of March 14, 2026, Benjamin Netanyahu continues to serve as the Prime Minister of Israel.
As of March 14, 2026, Benjamin Netanyahu is actively managing government operations.
Benjamin Netanyahu appeared in live broadcasts.
Benjamin Netanyahu appeared in press conferences.
Benjamin Netanyahu visited sites including a missile strike location in Beit Shemesh.
Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died originated from Iranian media.
Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died originated from social media posts.
Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died were specifically fact-checked.
Reports claiming that the Israeli Prime Minister has died were dismissed as "fake news".
Some rumors were spread using an AI-generated video.
The AI-generated video falsely showed Benjamin Netanyahu injured or dead in rubble.
The AI-generated video was flagged by AI detectors.
The rumors were part of a "disinformation campaign".
